description: Creates a new, empty Search project in your organization with the name given, and returns its project id. Counts against your plan's project limit. It does not import or index anything; use search_start_import next. The person confirms before it runs. Nothing happens until the person confirms: this returns a summary and a code for tc_confirm.

name.description: The project's name, e.g. the website it will search.

name: search_create_project
title: Create a Search project
